subject: Nvidia’s next act
notes: Genesis AI lead list reads "Eclipse 1led the round" in the text; taken as Eclipse.

stories.headline: Nvidia beats expectations with $115.8B quarterly revenue and raises forecast
stories.quote: Revenue for the three months ended October 25 came in at $115.8 billion, more than double the $57 billion recorded a year earlier and above analysts’ expectations of around $109 billion.
stories.description: AI chipmaker

facts.quote: Adjusted earnings per share were $2.68, topping estimates of $2.48.

facts.text: Fourth-quarter revenue forecast of $130B, plus or minus 3%, against an analyst estimate of $125B
facts.quote: The company forecasted fourth-quarter revenue of $130 billion, plus or minus 3%—a range that clears analysts’ $125 billion estimate even at the low end.

facts.text: Growth forecast for the fiscal year ending January 2028 raised to 75% from 70%
facts.quote: Management also raised its growth forecast for the fiscal year ending in January 2028 to 75%, from 70%.

stories.headline: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO; CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO and the board has no plans to reinstate him
stories.quote: just days after Jensen Huang resigned as CEO following reports of extramarital affairs. The upheaval sent the stock to its lowest level in well over a year.
stories.description: AI chipmaker

facts.text: Colette Kress, the longtime CFO, is serving as interim CEO
facts.quote: Will Colette Kress, the longtime CFO now serving as interim CEO, match his appetite for bankrolling the AI boom?

facts.text: Huang said he would like his old job back if the board asked; board chair Harvey Jones said there were no plans to reinstate him
facts.quote: said he’d love to have his old job back if the board asked. Board chair Harvey Jones said on the earnings call that there were no plans to reinstate him.

facts.text: Kress said Nvidia would remain thoughtful and disciplined in committing capital
facts.quote: But she also said the company would “remain thoughtful” and “disciplined” in committing capital, adding that Nvidia is “rigorously evaluating” future guarantees, investments and commitments.

facts.text: WSJ reported last week that Kress had questioned some of Nvidia's dealmaking under Huang
facts.quote: reported , citing people familiar with the matter, that Kress had questioned some of Nvidia’s dealmaking under Huang.

stories.headline: Nvidia's talks to raise more than $500B in third-party capital for AI infrastructure are still underway
stories.quote: The goal is to raise more than $500 billion in third-party capital for AI infrastructure. Those talks are still underway, Reuters
stories.description: AI chipmaker

facts.text: In August Nvidia announced a memorandum of understanding with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield Asset Management, Goldman Sachs and KKR
facts.quote: In August, Nvidia announced a memorandum of understanding—essentially a preliminary agreement—with some of Wall Street’s biggest firms: Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield Asset Management, Goldman Sachs and KKR.

facts.text: Reuters reported Monday that the talks are still underway, with no indication of a pause
facts.quote: reported Monday, with no indication from Nvidia of a pause.

stories.headline: Nvidia's announced $13B acquisition of Hugging Face cited as context
stories.quote: Not to mention its announced $13 billion acquisition of leading open-source repository Hugging Face.
stories.description: Open-source repository

stories.headline: Isomorphic Labs raised $5B Series C led by Greenoaks and Sequoia Capital
stories.quote: Isomorphic Labs, a London, U.K.-based AI-powered drug discovery company, raised $5 billion in Series C funding. Greenoaks and Sequoia Capital led the round and was joined by Andreessen Horowitz, Alphabet, ThriveCapital, and others.
stories.description: AI-powered drug discovery company

stories.headline: Genesis AI raised $500M Series A led by Premji Invest, Khosla Ventures and Eclipse
stories.quote: Genesis AI, a Paris- and San Carlos, Calif.-based developer of general-purpose robots, raised $500 million in Series A funding. Premji Invest, KhoslaVentures and Eclipse 1led the round and were joined by DurableCapitalPartners and others.
stories.description: Developer of general-purpose robots

stories.headline: Payhawk raised $280M Series C led by Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives
stories.quote: Payhawk, a London, U.K.-based provider of AI-powered spend management and finance software, raised $280 million in Series C funding. Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives led the round and was joined by existing investors QED, Greenoaks, Lightspeed, and others.
stories.description: AI-powered spend management and finance software
leads: Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives

stories.headline: Model ML raised $250M Series B led by General Atlantic and QED Investors
stories.quote: Model ML, a London-based provider of AI agents for financial and professional services, raised $250 million in Series B funding. General Atlantic and QED Investors led the round and were joined by Evolution Equity Partners, Airtree, ForestayCapital, and others.
stories.description: AI agents for financial and professional services

stories.headline: Hone Health raised $28M Series A equity plus $200M growth financing from General Catalyst's Customer Value Fund
stories.quote: Hone Health, a New York-based physician-led longevity care platform, raised $228 million in funding. The funding comprises $28 million in Series A equity led by MarcyPen CapitalPartners
stories.description: Physician-led longevity care platform

other_finance.note: growth financing from General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund; the issue gives $228 million as the total funding

facts.text: $200M of the $228M total is growth financing from General Catalyst's Customer Value Fund
facts.quote: and $200 million in growth financing from General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.

stories.headline: Ramon.Space raised $124M Series B led by PSG
stories.quote: Ramon.Space, a provider of space computing infrastructure, raised $124 million in Series B funding. PSG led the round, joined by MicronTechnology, Senvest, and others.
stories.description: Provider of space computing infrastructure

stories.headline: Remedy Robotics raised $62M Series B led by DCVC
stories.quote: Remedy Robotics, a San Francisco-based developer of AI-enabled robotic systems for cardiovascular interventions, raised $62 million in Series B funding. DCVC led the round and was joined by UC Investments, SkipCapital, and others.
stories.description: AI-enabled robotic systems for cardiovascular interventions

stories.headline: Aevius raised $22M led by Insight Partners
stories.quote: Aevius, a Boston, Mass.-based clinical intelligence company developing AI models to make medical data actionable for healthcare, payer and life sciences organizations, raised $22 million in funding. InsightPartners led the round.
stories.description: Clinical intelligence company developing AI models for medical data

stories.headline: Darcy Geothermal raised $15M Series B led by Aligned Climate Capital and Büetigen
stories.quote: Darcy Geothermal, a New Brighton, Minn.-based provider of geothermal heating and cooling systems for commercial buildings, campuses and thermal networks, raised $15 million in Series B funding. Aligned Climate Capital and Büetigen led the round.
stories.description: Geothermal heating and cooling systems for commercial buildings

stories.headline: Fermat raised $8M seed led by Kibo Ventures and Lunar Ventures
stories.quote: Fermat, a Barcelona, Spain-based AI platform for fashion design and production, raised $8 million in seed funding. KiboVentures and LunarVentures led the round.
stories.description: AI platform for fashion design and production

stories.headline: MountAIn raised €7.3M seed from 360 Capital and others
stories.quote: MountAIn, a Grenoble, France-based developer of software that runs AI applications on low-cost, low-power chips, raised €7.3 million ($8.03 million) in seed funding from 360 Capital and others.
stories.description: Software that runs AI applications on low-cost, low-power chips

stories.headline: Pretxt emerged from stealth with $5M seed
stories.quote: Pretxt, an Aspen, Colo.- and Dublin-based developer of runtime supervision software for enterprise AI agents, emerged from stealth with $5 million in seed funding from Deciens Capital, HowdyPartners, NSVWolfCapital, and ServiceProviderCapital.
stories.description: Runtime supervision software for enterprise AI agents

stories.headline: AstraNu raised $3.5M seed led by Celesta Capital
stories.quote: AstraNu, a Murray Hill, N.J.-based developer of chip-scale optical coherence tomography imaging technology for medical devices, raised $3.5 million in seed funding. Celesta Capital led the round.
stories.description: Chip-scale optical coherence tomography imaging for medical devices

stories.headline: Treat raised €3M pre-seed led by byFounders and Illusian
stories.quote: Treat, a Helsinki-based provider of AI-assisted intake and digital doctor consultations, raised €3 million ($3.3 million) in pre-seed funding. byFounders and Illusian led the round.
stories.description: AI-assisted intake and digital doctor consultations

stories.headline: Sqwish Labs raised $3M pre-seed led by Cambridge Enterprise Ventures
stories.quote: Sqwish Labs, a Cambridge, U.K.-based developer of AI decision models, raised $3 million in pre-seed funding. CambridgeEnterpriseVentures led the round.
stories.description: Developer of AI decision models

stories.headline: Mulga raised $1.77M pre-seed led by Rally Ventures and backtrace
stories.quote: Mulga, an Austin- and Brisbane-based developer of an open-source, AWS-compatible cloud platform, raised $1.77 million in pre-seed funding. Rally Ventures and backtrace led the round.
stories.description: Open-source, AWS-compatible cloud platform

stories.headline: EQT Transition Infrastructure agreed to acquire Flatiron Energy from Hull Street Energy; terms not disclosed
stories.quote: Flatiron Energy, a developer and operator of utility-scale battery storage projects across the Eastern U.S., from Hull Street Energy. Financial terms were not disclosed.
stories.description: Developer and operator of utility-scale battery storage projects

stories.headline: Funds managed by Centerbridge Partners acquired Amplix from Gemspring Capital; terms not disclosed
stories.quote: Amplix, a Norwood, Mass.-based provider of technology advisory, consulting, implementation and managed services, from GemspringCapital. Financial terms were not disclosed.
stories.description: Technology advisory, consulting, implementation and managed services

stories.headline: Core Specialty Insurance filed to go public on the NYSE
stories.quote: Core Specialty Insurance, a Cincinnati, Ohio-based provider of specialty insurance to small and midsize businesses, filed to go public on the New York Stock Exchange.
stories.description: Specialty insurance for small and midsize businesses

facts.text: Backers: SkyKnight Capital, Dragoneer, Enstar, Aquiline Capital Partners, and Dave and Tim Delaney
facts.quote: SkyKnight Capital, Dragoneer, Enstar, AquilineCapitalPartners, and Dave and Tim Delaney back the company.

stories.headline: Argonaut Private Equity closed its sixth fund at $606M
stories.quote: Argonaut Private Equity, a Tulsa, Okla.-based private equity firm, closed its sixth fund at $606 million focused on industrial businesses in Middle America.
stories.description: Private equity firm
